data.one_liner: Flutter widget to render Apache ECharts data visualization libraries via WebView.
data.what_it_does: A Flutter widget that embeds Apache ECharts to display advanced charts such as WebGL 3D, GIS maps, lines, bars, and pies in a reactive manner. It supports two-way communication between Flutter and JavaScript, and configurable extensions.
use_when: You need complex data visualization charts powered by Apache ECharts.
You require advanced chart types like 3D charts, heatmaps, or GIS maps.
avoid_when: You want a purely native rendering chart library to avoid webview instability or performance issues.
You are building performance-critical charts inside scrolling lists where webview overhead causes lag.
strengths: Access to the rich feature set and diverse chart types of Apache ECharts.
Supports reactive updating of charts when the option property changes.
Two-way communication between Flutter and JavaScript via custom scripts and message handlers.
weaknesses: Relies on a WebView underneath, which can introduce performance and stability issues.
Requires passing configurations as raw JavaScript/JSON strings.

alternatives.name: fl_chart
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick it for a purely native Flutter charting library without webview overhead.

alternatives.name: syncfusion_flutter_charts
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick it for a robust, feature-rich, and native set of business charts.
